justification: Inspected [BndGenerator.java](./javaparser-core-generators/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/generator/core/other/BndGenerator.java) and [CoreGenerator.java](./javaparser-core-generators/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/generator/core/CoreGenerator.java). `BndGenerator` is a small, single-purpose generator: one constructor, one public `generate()` method, and two private helpers; its outgoing dependencies are limited to `Generator`, `SourceRoot`, `Log`, and standard JDK file/stream APIs. Repo-wide search found only one incoming code reference, `new BndGenerator(sourceRoot).generate()` in `CoreGenerator.java:99`, so there is no evidence of the high fan-in and high fan-out required for a hub-like modularization smell.
